blocks.caption: Pros and cons of generate and test
rows: Simplicity: easy to understand and implement for simple problems
Inefficiency: may test many candidates in large problem spaces
Versatility: works for many problems with no clear strategy
No optimality guarantee: finds a valid solution, not necessarily the best
Exhaustiveness: explores all solutions, so none is overlooked
Computational expense: impractical when there are vast numbers of candidates

blocks.text: Generate and test is often used in artificial intelligence, such as game playing, where the best approach is to try different possibilities until one works (Did You Know).

blocks.alt: Three boxes: GENERATOR at the top, TESTER in the middle and STOP at the bottom right. An arrow labelled Possible Solution goes from GENERATOR down to TESTER; an arrow labelled Correct Solution goes from TESTER down to STOP; a line labelled Incorrect Solution leaves TESTER and loops back up into GENERATOR.
